name: Red Galaxy
summary:
Red Galaxy is a massively multiplayer online space shooter for Windows, Android and iOS. Players pilot a customizable ship on behalf of one of three rival corporations, Orion, Helios and Nova, and compete for control of contested map sectors.

Gameplay combines player versus player combat, cooperative raids through multi stage gates, NPC hunting, and resource collection. Ore gathered in space can be refined into enrichment that boosts damage, shielding or speed for a limited time. Ships are configured through hangars with modular weapons, generators, drones and rockets, and progression is driven by a research tree, ranks and a quest chain.

Players can form clans, take part in auctions, and trade through an in game economy built on credits, red matter and a premium currency. The game is free to play with optional purchases and is in early access, with content and balance still being expanded.
